program.section_heading: Small Business Startup, Marketing & Media - Non-Credit - COC
outcomes: Identify problem solving and decision-making techniques.
Demonstrate a proficiency in computer skills typically used in the workplace.
Distinctive problem-solving, strategic and analytical capabilities.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with an ability to influence at executive levels.
Display and demonstrate an awareness of appropriate professional behavior
Demonstrated ability to apply data in driving strategy, prioritizing, and making decisions and recommendations.
Possess sound business insight and strategic skills.
Identify skills needed to be success in business start-up.

notes: The catalog labels the figures 'credits', but this is a noncredit Certificate of Completion and the per-course figures (36, 48.06-162) are hours, so measure is recorded as hours.

'Requirements (Total 156.06 - 270)' equals the sum of all four courses (36+36+48.06+36 to 36+36+162+36) and matches the program's 'Credits: 156.06 - 270.0'. It is recorded as total_units rather than as the Requirements block's stated total.

The Recommended Sequence conflicts with the requirements list. Term 1 says 'Take one of the following: BA0504 or BA0505', and Term 2 lists BA0504 again. The Program Requirements section requires all of BA0505, CSCI0501, WORK0512 and BA0504. The requirements section was followed.
The catalog prints codes without a space (CSCI0501, WORK0512). These match the closed list's CSCI 501 and WORK 512.
BA0504 and BA0505 are not in the closed list and are marked as catalog additions.
The PSLO list is printed for the program as a whole, and this award shares it. 'Identify skills needed to be success in business start-up.' is copied as printed.
The page carries a Winter 2023 start-date rationale, although the catalog year is 2026-2027.
